result.title: trACT: temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap
result.summary: Effective remote monitoring and surveillance using drones are frequently impeded by severe environmental and thermal clutter, dynamic vegetation, target camouflage, and system latency. Drawing inspiration from the hunting strategies of birds of prey that hover and stabilize their vision to isolate subtle ground motion, we introduce trACT (temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap), a lightweight, real-time aerial robotics framework designed for autonomous consumer drones. The system integrates Temporal Max Pooling (TMP), a low-level signal processing method that transforms imperceptible movement across a rolling integration window into robust value and time encodings, with self-supervised motion anomaly detection to isolate target motion from background environmental motion caused by wind gusts and drone drift. To overcome mechanical and processing delays, trACT combines motion prediction with automated gimbal-stabilized optical zoom verification and equitable multi-target verification balancing. Extensive real-world field experiments in densely forested wildlife habitats and surveillance scenarios demonstrate that trACT successfully bridges the gap between wide-area aerial monitoring and precise, autonomous target verification under challenging operational conditions.

AI.brief_summary: trACT 是一个面向消费级无人机的轻量实时空中监测框架，利用时序最大池化把滚动积分窗口内的微弱运动编码为数值与时间信号，并结合自监督运动异常检测与云台稳定光学变焦进行目标验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「运动预测＋按需触发变焦验证＋多目标验证资源分配」可能为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选提供线索，但属远领域启发，需核查其停止准则与分配策略能否迁移。
